map.按你输入的月收入、支付比例与当地生活水平估算每月抚养费，比例上限 50%，不构成: Estimate monthly child support from the income, payment ratio and local living level you enter, capped at 50% of income. This is not legal advice.
map.📖 查看「抚养费计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Child Support Calculator User Guide"
map.基础抚养费/月 = max(支付方月收入 × 支付比例, 当地实际生活水平)，支: Base support/month = max(payer monthly income × payment ratio, local actual living standard), with the ratio capped at 50%; per child/month = base support ÷ number of children; education/medical share/month = annual special expenses × sharing ratio ÷ 12; total payable/month = base support + education/medical share; total through age 18 = total payable × remaining months (18 − child's age) × 12.
map.按你输入的收入、比例与生活水平做算术估算：比例由下拉选择或自定义输入决定，超过: Arithmetic estimate from the income, ratio and living standard you enter: the ratio comes from the dropdown or your custom input and is capped at 50%; the living standard is a floor, and the larger of the two is used. The tool does not embed any judicial-interpretation ratio table, and the result is not legal advice.
map.页面提供 20%、30%、45% 三档与自定义输入，比例超过 50% 时按 50: The page offers 20%, 30% and 45% presets plus a custom input, and caps anything above 50% at 50%. Common reference ranges are 20%–30% for one child and somewhat higher for two or more, but this tool only computes the value you select.
map.以你填写的“当地实际生活水平”为下限，若收入 × 比例低于该值则按该值计。: The "local actual living standard" you enter is the floor; if income × ratio falls below it, the floor is used.
map.页面按子女现龄到 18 周岁估算剩余月数，用于计算“至 18 岁总额”，不涉及其: The page estimates remaining months from the child's current age to 18 for the "total through age 18" figure and does not model any other statutory extension.
map.本工具不判断是否应增减抚养费；大额教育/医疗支出仅在勾选后按年度金额与分摊比例折: The tool does not decide whether support should be raised or lowered; large education/medical expenses are converted to a monthly share only when ticked, using the annual amount and sharing ratio.
map.协议离婚或调解时，按双方约定的收入与比例快速估算抚养费，作为沟通参考。: For divorce by agreement or mediation, quickly estimate support from the income and ratio both sides agree on, as a reference for discussion.
map.多子女时，对比不同总比例下每名子女的分摊金额。: With several children, compare the per-child share under different total ratios.
map.子女有大额教育/医疗支出时，把年度金额与分摊比例折算为月摊额。: When there are large education/medical expenses, convert the annual amount and sharing ratio into a monthly share.
map.一孩：支付方月收入 1.5 万元、比例 20%: One child: payer income 15,000 CNY, 20% ratio
map.基础抚养费 = max(15000 × 20%, 当地生活水平 2000) =: Base support = max(15000 × 20%, local living standard 2000) = 3,000 CNY/month; with one child the share stays 3,000 CNY/month. If the living standard is raised to 3,500, the 3,500 CNY floor applies.
map.两孩：总比例上浮: Two children: a higher total ratio
map.同一收入 1.5 万元、总比例 30% 时，基础抚养费 4500 元/月，每名子: On the same 15,000 CNY income at a 30% total ratio, base support = 4,500 CNY/month and each child gets 2,250 CNY/month; the total through age 18 = 4,500 × (18 − current age) × 12.
map.本工具用的比例是法定标准吗？: Is the ratio used here a statutory standard?
map.不是。比例来自下拉选项或你的自定义输入，超过 50% 按 50% 计；工具只做算: No. The ratio comes from the dropdown or your custom input, and anything above 50% is capped at 50%. The tool only does arithmetic and does not embed any judicial-interpretation ratio table; the result is not legal advice.
map.生活水平保底怎么算？: How does the living-standard floor work?
map.基础抚养费取“月收入 × 比例”与“当地实际生活水平”两者的较大值；后者是你自己: Base support takes the larger of "monthly income × ratio" and "local actual living standard"; the latter is the floor you enter yourself, not a local standard looked up by the system.
map.大额教育/医疗支出怎么处理？: How are large education/medical expenses handled?
map.勾选后按“年度特殊支出 × 分摊比例 ÷ 12”折算为月摊额，加到每月应支付；未: Once ticked, they are converted with "annual special expenses × sharing ratio ÷ 12" and added to the monthly total; otherwise they are excluded.
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器: The tool runs entirely in the front end; data is never uploaded to a server.
map.建议在主流浏览器（Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge）中使用: Use a mainstream browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge).
map.结果为按输入数值的算术估算，比例上限 50%，生活水平为保底下限；不构成法律意见: Results are arithmetic estimates from your inputs: the ratio is capped at 50% and the living standard is a floor; this is not legal advice, and the final amount is set by agreement between the parties or by a court ruling.
map.按你输入的支付方月收入、支付比例、当地生活水平与子女数量，估算每月抚养费与至 1: Estimate monthly child support and the total through age 18 from the payer's monthly income, payment ratio, local living standard and number of children you enter; the ratio is capped at 50%, and annual education/medical expense sharing can be added. All computation runs locally in the front end and is not legal advice.
map.收入 × 比例与生活水平取较大值，避免低于保底: Takes the larger of income × ratio and the living standard, so the floor is never undercut.
map.多子女按总比例分摊到每名子女: Splits the total ratio among multiple children.
map.年度教育/医疗支出可按分摊比例折算为月摊额: Annual education/medical expenses can be converted to a monthly share.
map.纯前端计算，数据不上传: Pure front-end computation; data is never uploaded.
map.协议离婚或调解时的抚养费沟通参考: A reference for discussions in divorce by agreement or mediation.
map.多子女与不同比例下的分摊对比: Compare per-child shares across several children and different ratios.
map.大额教育/医疗支出的月摊估算: Estimate the monthly share of large education/medical expenses.
map.协议或诉讼离婚时，按支付方月收入比例估算子女抚养费，确定合理数额。: When divorcing by agreement or litigation, estimate child support as a proportion of the payer's monthly income to determine a reasonable amount.
map.抚养多个子女时，比例可适当提高但通常不超过月总收入 50%。: With multiple children the proportion may be raised appropriately but usually does not exceed 50% of monthly total income.
map.子女患重大疾病等大额支出，可另行主张分担，不限于按月抚养费。: For major expenses such as a child's serious illness, an additional share may be claimed, not limited to the monthly support.
map.一孩：支付方月收入 1.5 万元: One child: payer's monthly income 15,000 CNY
map.按 20% 比例，基础抚养费 = 15000 × 20% = 3000 元/月；: At 20%, basic support = 15000 × 20% = 3,000 CNY/month; if local living costs are higher, the tool notes that support should not fall below the amount corresponding to the local minimum living guarantee.
map.同一收入 1.5 万元，两孩按 25% 比例 = 3750 元/月；支付至子女满: With the same income of 15,000 CNY, two children at 25% = 3,750 CNY/month; payable until the child turns 18, years = 18 − current age.
map.抚养费比例有法定标准吗？: Is there a statutory standard for the support proportion?
map.有参照比例：有固定收入的按月总收入 20%–30% 给付，两孩以上一般不超过 5: There is a reference proportion: with fixed income, 20%–30% of monthly total income, generally not exceeding 50% for two or more children; without fixed income, the same proportion applies to the total income of the year or the average income of the same industry.
map.包括子女生活费、教育费、医疗费等；择校费、大额医疗费等超出基本范围的支出，可协商: It includes the child's living, education and medical expenses; expenses beyond the basic scope, such as selective school fees and large medical bills, may be shared by agreement or by court order.
